Ted Lasso returns for its fourth season tonight and is sure to spark another wave of buzz. However, the latest data reveals that Apple TV+'s most popular series this year actually comes from the same creator.

Nielsen data shows that Shrinking is the most-watched Apple TV+ series so far in 2026

Apple TV+ does not officially release viewership figures for its shows and films, although keeping a close eye on the daily updated top 10 charts can give a reasonable sense of audience preferences.

In the streaming industry, keeping actual viewership data under wraps is a common practice. Among the many third-party audience measurement firms, however, Nielsen has long been regarded as the industry gold standard.

Nielsen recently released data for the first half of 2026, covering viewership across the major streaming platforms.

Apple TV+ content rarely makes it into Nielsen's rankings, but one series — Shrinking, produced by one of the co-creators of Ted Lasso — has just squeezed into the top 20 of the "original series" viewership chart.

"Original series" refers to works that premiere on streaming platforms, which is why long-running classics with massive libraries such as Grey's Anatomy and The Big Bang Theory do not qualify.

According to Nielsen data, Shrinking ranks 20th on the original series chart with 5.2 billion minutes of viewing time, making it the most-watched Apple TV+ series released this year.

The show is neck and neck with other titles hovering around the 5 billion-minute mark, such as Love Is Blind and Paradise. A slight rise in viewership could easily push it up to as high as 14th place.

Stranger Things and The Pitt occupy the top two spots with 23 billion and 21 billion minutes of viewing time respectively.

For an Apple series, simply making it onto the Nielsen chart is no small feat. The new season of Ted Lasso is almost certain to rank high on the list. And the good news for Apple (and viewers) is that Shrinking is expected to return for its fourth season next year.

Were you surprised by Nielsen's viewership rankings? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, with discount bundles available through an Apple One subscription.
